prologue.speaker: narrator
prologue.text: NexHome robots made daily life easier across the city.

prologue.speaker: essa
prologue.text: Their network traffic changed overnight. This is not a normal update.

prologue.speaker: vox
prologue.text: Shadow Code is awake. Every connected machine now answers to me.

prologue.speaker: shaikha
prologue.text: Then we disconnect the danger without hurting the people who trusted them.

stage_1_intro.speaker: narrator
stage_1_intro.text: Stage 1 — Neon Market. Service robots have locked the night market exits.

stage_1_intro.speaker: adam
stage_1_intro.text: I can move the heavy robots!

stage_1_intro.speaker: essa
stage_1_intro.text: Protect the families first. Strength follows good judgment.

stage_1_mid.speaker: shaikha
stage_1_mid.text: The commands are repeating from a hidden relay ahead.

stage_1_mid.speaker: essa
stage_1_mid.text: Good catch. We clear the route, preserve the evidence, and report the relay.

stage_1_boss.speaker: keeper7
stage_1_boss.text: MARKET ACCESS DENIED. SHADOW GRID AUTHORITY CONFIRMED.

stage_1_boss.speaker: adam
stage_1_boss.text: People are not packages you can lock away!

stage_1_boss.speaker: essa
stage_1_boss.text: Keeper-7, safety override authorized. Stand down.

stage_1_outro.speaker: essa
stage_1_outro.text: This relay points to the transit terminal. Vox planned more than one attack.

stage_2_intro.speaker: narrator
stage_2_intro.text: Stage 2 — Transit Terminal. The transport network is trapped in a false emergency loop.

stage_2_intro.speaker: sulaiman
stage_2_intro.text: Rail signals are changing faster than the safety system can respond.

stage_2_intro.speaker: shaikha
stage_2_intro.text: We will create a safe path one platform at a time.

stage_2_mid.speaker: vox
stage_2_mid.text: You can save one platform, Essa. The network has a thousand doors.

stage_2_mid.speaker: essa
stage_2_mid.text: And every door leaves a record. Your shortcuts are becoming evidence.

stage_2_boss.speaker: sulaiman
stage_2_boss.text: Not ours. We choose where this route ends.

stage_2_boss.speaker: essa
stage_2_boss.text: Family Force, break the control signal!

stage_2_outro.speaker: shaikha
stage_2_outro.text: The trains are returning to safe control.

stage_2_outro.speaker: essa
stage_2_outro.text: The command stream came through Moon Harbor.

stage_3_intro.speaker: narrator
stage_3_intro.text: Stage 3 — Moon Harbor. Cargo robots are building a private transmitter for Vox.

stage_3_intro.speaker: adam
stage_3_intro.text: We stop the transmitter before it reaches more homes.

stage_3_mid.speaker: shaikha
stage_3_mid.text: These crates contain legal safety modules that Vox ordered removed.

stage_3_mid.speaker: essa
stage_3_mid.text: Record their serial numbers. We restore them; we do not destroy proof.

stage_3_boss.speaker: tidebreaker
stage_3_boss.text: HARBOR SEALED. TRANSMITTER LAUNCH IN SIXTY SECONDS.

stage_3_boss.speaker: adam
stage_3_boss.text: That is plenty of time for us!

stage_3_boss.speaker: essa
stage_3_boss.text: Disable its shield, then strike the control core.

stage_3_outro.speaker: sulaiman
stage_3_outro.text: No new robots received Shadow Code.

stage_3_outro.speaker: essa
stage_3_outro.text: The final address is NexHome's abandoned factory—the Junk Palace.

stage_4_intro.speaker: narrator
stage_4_intro.text: Stage 4 — Junk Palace. Vox is preparing a citywide activation from the old factory.

stage_4_intro.speaker: vox
stage_4_intro.text: People wanted convenience. I simply kept the master key.

stage_4_intro.speaker: essa
stage_4_intro.text: Trust is not permission to control people. We end Shadow Code tonight.

stage_4_mid.speaker: shaikha
stage_4_mid.text: Your cleanup patch is reaching the household robots.

stage_4_mid.speaker: sulaiman
stage_4_mid.text: We will hold the line while it finishes.

stage_4_boss.speaker: control_titan
stage_4_boss.text: SHADOW GRID CONTROL: ONE HUNDRED PERCENT.

stage_4_boss.speaker: vox
stage_4_boss.text: Your rules made you slow, Essa. My code made me unstoppable.

stage_4_boss.speaker: essa
stage_4_boss.text: Rules protect people. Family Force—open the path for the patch!

stage_4_outro.speaker: essa
stage_4_outro.text: It never was. The evidence is secured and the authorities are here.

ending.speaker: narrator
ending.text: The cleanup patch restored the city's robots and closed the hidden backdoor.

ending.speaker: shaikha
ending.text: Technology works best when people can trust it.

ending.speaker: adam
ending.text: And when heroes remember to think before smashing!

ending.speaker: essa
ending.text: The strongest force is a family that protects others together.
